descriptionHtml:
AOC Q27G4Z 27 Inch QHD Fast IPS 260Hz (OC) Gaming Monitor with Adjustable Stand

Experience the pinnacle of high-resolution competitive gaming with the AOC Q27G4Z 27 Inch QHD gaming monitor, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a crystal-clear 2K QHD 2560x1440 Fast IPS panel, this display delivers incredibly sharp details alongside an elite, overclocked 260Hz refresh rate (240Hz Native) and a blistering 0.5ms MPRT response time for crisp, blur-free motion graphics. Outfitted with premium VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification and a wide color gamut covering 118% sRGB and 97% DCI-P3, it produces 1.07 billion vibrant colors with deep contrast. Designed for long-session ergonomics, the fully adjustable stand offers seamless height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments to match your exact comfort level. This advanced 2K gaming display is backed by a reliable 3-year agency warranty structure.
